items.given: an inbound folder containing a valid newline-delimited JSON trade file with 3 trades
items.when: the service runs a reconciliation cycle
items.then: all 3 trades appear in the in-memory trade list with fields identical to the equivalent legacy MSMQ TradeMessage payload

items.given: a trade with SettlementDate 2024-01-10 and a settlement record with the same TradeId and SettlementDate within tolerance
a trade with no settlement record within 3 business days of its SettlementDate
items.then: the trade appears in exceptions.csv with reason UNSETTLED

items.given: a settlement record with no corresponding trade
items.then: the settlement record appears in exceptions.csv with reason ORPHAN_SETTLEMENT

items.given: a configured tolerance of 0.05 and a trade/settlement pair differing by exactly 0.05
items.then: the pair is classified MATCHED (closed-interval tolerance, see INV-3)

items.given: two trades sharing the same (TradeId, SettlementDate) and a settlement record that would otherwise match one of them within tolerance
items.then: both trades appear in exceptions.csv with reason DUPLICATE_TRADE_KEY, and neither consumes the settlement record

items.given: an input set that produces zero exceptions
items.then: exceptions.csv is written containing only the header row, and matched.csv contains the expected header and rows

items.given: the same pair of inbound trade and settlement files
items.when: reconciliation is run twice without modifying the inputs
items.then: the two runs produce byte-identical matched.csv and exceptions.csv

items.given: one of the 12 golden fixed-width settlement files from the historical regression set
items.then: the parsed settlement records are field-for-field identical to the legacy parser's output for the same file
